mapper.select: select nr.id, nr.is_deleted, nr.customer_id, nr.item_id, nr.nursing_time, nr.nursing_content, nr.nursing_count, nr.user_id, u.nickname, u.phone_number, nc.serial_number, nc.nursing_name from nurserecord nr, user u, nursecontent nc where nr.user_id = u.id and nr.item_id = nc.id and nr.is_deleted = 0 and nr.customer_id = #{customerId}
